title: Introduce media input normalization, data URL conversion, and provider attachment resolver boundaries
description: Rust has audio loading and provider-specific data-URL requirements, while AstrBot provider sources download/encode images and normalize file/base64/HTTP inputs before provider serialization. Add a provider-neutral media normalization boundary before image, audio, attachment, and WebChat upload parity spreads conversion policy across provider protocol modules and web handlers.

files.change: Resolve file, URL, attachment, and base64 references into typed media bytes or deferred descriptors.
Centralize provider data URL encoding/decoding and MIME validation outside protocol modules.
Share auth-isolated media download policy across image and audio paths.
Keep protocol modules consuming normalized media references instead of owning download/encoding rules.

criteria: Provider protocol modules no longer duplicate image data URL parsing and remote-url rejection policy.
WebChat attachments and platform media uploads can resolve through the same media boundary.
Provider authorization headers are never reused for third-party media downloads.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
